# NVO987 Cryptographic & Digital Infrastructure

> Independent cryptographic software applications and digital tools
> maintained under the NVO987 namespace.

## Overview

NVO987 Cryptographic & Digital Infrastructure is a directory of
web-based software utilities maintained under the NVO987 namespace.

The website provides access to independent applications for
cryptographic hashing, data-format processing, identifier generation,
and related digital tasks.

- Website: https://software.nvo987.us/
- Maintainer: Nicholas Van-Orton
- Contact: nvo@nvo987.us
- Main website: https://nvo987.us/
- Identity infrastructure: https://identity.nvo987.us/

## Applications

- [Favicon](https://favicon.nvo987.us/): Favicon-related utility.
- [Keccak-256 and Whirlpool](https://keccak.nvo987.us/): Hash utilities.
- [BLAKE2 and BLAKE3](https://blake.nvo987.us/): Hash utilities.
- [SHA-1](https://sha1.nvo987.us/): SHA-1 hashing utility.
- [SHA-512](https://sha512.nvo987.us/): SHA-512 hashing utility.
- [SHA3-256](https://sha3.nvo987.us/): SHA3-256 hashing utility.
- [JSON and XML](https://json.nvo987.us/): Data-format utilities.
- [SHA-256](https://sha256.nvo987.us/): SHA-256 hashing utility.
- [UUID Generator](https://uuid.nvo987.us/): UUID generation utility.
- [QR Code Generator](https://qr.nvo987.us/): QR code generation utility.
- [SHA Suite](https://sha.nvo987.us/): SHA-related utilities.

## Cryptographic Notes

SHA-1 is not recommended for applications requiring modern collision
resistance.

SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA3-256, Keccak, BLAKE2, and BLAKE3 have different
technical properties and should not be treated as interchangeable.

Hashing is not encryption. A cryptographic hash generally cannot be
reversed to recover its input.

The actual behavior, security, and privacy properties of each
application must be verified against its implementation.

## Data and Privacy

Do not assume that all application inputs are processed locally.

Users should consult each application's implementation and privacy
documentation before submitting sensitive data.
